Subject:        Report of Changes to Palisades Nuclear Plant Security Plan , Revision 22

In accordance with Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations Part 50 (10 CFR 50), Section 54,
Conditions of licenses, paragraph (p)(2), (10 CFR 50.54(p)(2)), Holtec Palisades , LLC (Holtec
Palisades) hereby submits Revision 22 to the Palisades Nuclear Plant (PNP) Physical Security
Plan (PSP). The Enclosure contains a description and basis for each change included in PSP
Revision 21 B. Revision 22 of the PSP is provided as an Attachment to the Enclosure.

The changes made to the PSP were analyzed as required by 10 CFR 50.54(p)(2) . The analysis
concluded that the changes do not decrease the safeguards effectiveness of the PSP.
Accordingly, this revision is submitted under the provisions of 10 CFR 50.54(p)(2) .

Information contained in the Enclosure and Attachment to this document has been classified as
Safeguards information. Therefore, Holtec Palisades requests that this information be withheld
from public disclosure in accordance with 10 CFR 73.22 , Protection of Safeguards Information:
Specific Requirements.

This letter contains no new commitments and no revised commitments.

Should you have any questions or require additional information, please contact me at
(269) 764-2375.

Respectfully,

                Oigitalty aigned by Kamt J _ M1Uer
